description: Use for "any edge on Kalshi", "where is the edge today" and "weather trade signals". Our model alerts on Kalshi — weather, bitcoin/silver/gold/oil, mispricings — with feed, tier, side, price, model probability, edge and link. Real time with Pro; free is delayed 24h without the thesis. One identical, impersonal feed for every subscriber; filters only select. Informational, not investment advice.

feed.description: Comma-separated feeds to include: weather, bitcoin, silver, gold, oil, mispricing, sports_arb, nfl. Omit for all.

limit.description: Max alerts to return (default 25; 4 when the call has no arguments).

min_tier.description: Minimum confidence tier (returns that tier and above). One of: SPECULATIVE · MODERATE · STRONG.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only alerts created after it.

name: edge_alerts

alerts.description: Today's graded edges: feed, market, side, edge, tier, when.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `since` for the next page.

tell_user.description: Show this sentence to the user first.

title: Edge Alerts (weather / commodity / mispricing)
